# Lesson Chunks Agent

> A free Hermes agent profile that turns lessons into accessible chunks, builds an interactive single-file lesson, and schedules spaced delivery in chat before a test.

The agent edition of the Lesson Chunks AI app. It runs on the family's or teacher's own machine, keeps every source document and answer on disk, and works local-first with the option of frontier models online.

## What it does

- Ingests any lesson source: pasted text, a photo, a PDF or a Word document.
- Plans 5 to 12 chunks, one idea each, in an order that builds.
- Writes each chunk to a strict format spec: 90 words maximum, 15-word sentences, one task per chunk, reading level year 8.
- Gates every lesson through ten automated quality checks before anything is built.
- Builds one self-contained lesson.html with chunk navigation, a timer, read-aloud, autosaving answers and clean printing.
- Schedules spaced delivery in Telegram (or WhatsApp where connected): one chunk per message, recall questions from earlier chunks, and a five-question sweep before the test.

## Links

- Agent repository and download: https://github.com/boktoday/lesson-chunks-hermes-agent
- Live example, no install: https://boktoday.github.io/lesson-chunks-hermes-agent/demo/lesson.html
- Human help, workshops and setup: https://lessonchunks.distinctoapps.com/hire.html
